snippet.title: Denshattack! | Official Music & Talent Reveal Trailer | Original Soundtrack Preview
snippet.description:
The rails have a new sound. 🚄🎶

🎧 Listen to the Denshattack! soundtrack preview here:
https://kidkatana.ffm.to/denshattack-ost

Developer Undercoders and publisher Fireshine Games are proud to reveal the music behind Denshattack!, the high-speed train-flipping trick platformer coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox this spring.

This special music reveal trailer showcases a selection of tracks from Denshattack!’s electrifying original soundtrack. featuring an all-star lineup of legendary video game composers and global music artists.

🎼 Featured Composers
Tee Lopes
Shoji Meguro
Andrew One
Sean Bialo
2 Mello
Ryo Nagamatsu
The Noble Demon
Harumi Fujita “OkanP”
Kohta Takahashi
Toni Leys
Richard Jacques

🎤 Featured Performers
Takenobu Mitsuyoshi
Lotus Juice
MIYACHI
Alice Peralta
milkyPRISM
JUNKY58%
The DO DO DO’s
Yunosuke

Managed by Kid Katana Records

🚄 About Denshattack!
Flip, trick and grind your train through a colourful Japanese dystopia in this fast-paced, off-the-rails platformer. Master fluid trick systems across 50+ levels, challenge rival gangs, and race toward legendary status across a reimagined Japan.

Inspired by the spirit, speed, and culture of Japan’s railway systems, Denshattack! blends extreme action gameplay with a vibrant cross-generational soundtrack combining:

- Electrifying electronic & breakbeat
- Arcade-inspired Y2K hip-hop
- Punk energy & funk grooves
- Retro game textures fused with modern production

📍Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524850/Denshattack/

🎮Play the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4142750/Denshattack_Demo/
